name.ja: ３０ＭＭ 1/144 eEXM-17A アルト（Ｘ７７７部隊所属機）

description.ja: エグザマクスの登場により、地球、宇宙、惑星、あらゆる場所に戦場が広がっていった。
description.en: With the appearance of Examacus, battlefields have spread across the Earth, space, and planets.

description.ja: 数多の量産機が投入されたその戦場の中で、勝敗を左右したとされる機体たちがあった。
description.en: Among the many mass-produced aircraft that were introduced into the battlefield, there were some that were said to have a decisive influence on victory or defeat.

description.ja: これは英雄たちの記録である。
description.en: This is a record of heroes.

description.ja: eEXM-17A ALTO (X777 CORPS)－
description.en: eEXM-17A ALTO (X777 CORPS)－

description.ja: 30MM 1/144 eEXM-17A ｱﾙﾄ (X777部隊所属機)
description.en: 30MM 1/144 eEXM-17A Alto (X777 unit affiliation machine)

description.ja: 『30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN』
description.en: 『30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN』

description.ja: https://bandai-hobby.net/site/30mmaep/
description.en: https://bandai-hobby.net/site/30mmaep/

description.ja: 『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』の戦場に残された、英雄たちの記録をつづった新企画
description.en: A new project that chronicles the heroes left behind on the battlefield of “30 MINUTES MISSIONS”

description.ja: 『30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN』よりe-EXM17 アルト (X777部隊所属機)が登場。
description.en: From "30 MINUTES MISSIONS ANOTHER EXAMACS PLAN" comes the e-EXM17 Alto (X777 unit belonging machine).

description.ja: 頭部アーマー、肩部は新規造形。専用カラーリングを採用。新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: The head armor and shoulders are newly sculpted. Adopts exclusive coloring. A newly designed water slide decal is included.

description.ja: さらに様々なカスタマイズ用パーツを同梱。『30MINUTES MISSIONS』の魅力が詰まったオールインワンセット。
description.en: Furthermore, various customization parts are included. An all-in-one set packed with the charm of "30 MINUTES MISSIONS".

description.ja: ●　デザイナー海老川兼武氏監修！地球連合軍特務機の専用装備を新規造形で立体化！
description.en: ● Supervised by designer Kanetake Ebikawa! The special equipment of the Earth Allied Forces special mission aircraft is now three-dimensional with new modeling!

description.ja: デザイナー海老川兼武氏監修の機体を立体化。
description.en: Three-dimensional version of the aircraft supervised by designer Kanetake Ebikawa.

description.ja: 特務機用の頭部アーマーと、肩部は新規造形。
description.en: The head armor for the special mission machine and the shoulders are newly sculpted.

description.ja: ●　新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属！
description.en: ● Newly designed water transfer decal included!

description.ja: 本機体の専用マーキングや、ライン等を収録した、新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: A newly designed water transfer decal containing special markings and lines for this unit is included.

description.ja: ●　専用カラーリング仕様で特務機を商品化！
description.en: ● Commercialize a special mission machine with special coloring specifications!

description.ja: 本体及びオプションパーツの成型色は、専用カラーリングを採用。
description.en: The molding color of the main body and optional parts uses a special coloring.

description.ja: 特務機の特殊な機体色を表現。
description.en: Expressing the special body color of the special mission aircraft.

description.ja: ●　自分専用にカスタマイズ可能！豊富なカスタマイズ用パーツが付属。
description.en: ● Customizable for your own use! Comes with a wide variety of customization parts.

description.ja: 本体を構成するパーツの他、カスタマイズ用パーツも付属。
description.en: In addition to the parts that make up the main body, customization parts are also included.

description.ja: 自分専用機へのカスタマイズも可能なオールインワンセット！
description.en: An all-in-one set that allows you to customize your own machine!

description.ja: セット内容 ： アルト(X777部隊所属機)一式 ／ カスタマイズ用パーツ一式 ／ 水転写式デカール
description.en: Set contents: Complete set of Alto (X777 unit belonging machine) / Complete set of customization parts / Water slide decal
